en.title: Montgomery - Native Computer Vision in Rust
en.description: Montgomery is an experimental native Rust stack for WGPU training and computer vision inference on CPUs and GPUs, with no Python, PyTorch or ONNX Runtime required for normal inference.
en.keywords: Montgomery, Rust, computer vision, AI training, GPU, WGPU, object detection, instance segmentation, image classification, YOLO, ONNX
en.hero.p: Native object detection, instance segmentation and image classification in Rust with Burn.
en.why.title: Why Montgomery?
en.feat1: Native computer vision inference on CPU or GPU
en.feat2: WGPU training with validation and resumable checkpoints
en.feat3: Object detection, instance segmentation and image classification
en.feat4: No Python, no PyTorch, no CUDA, it just works
en.models.title: Supported Models
